changeReport: Added 31 locally scoped CANON entries across the six authorized topical universe files, covering every ordered delta bullet and citing stories/a-crown-of-quiet-hours/05-story.md in every entry. Preserved the unnamed kingdom, capital, and era; the exact twelve-person collective; all quantities, durations, causes, consequences, capabilities, costs, institutions, and six glossary terms; non-agentic civic systems; and distinct identities. Explicitly separated Kharost’s collective from the Sleepless Majesty, Ersene, Qarsis, other dragons, transformation systems, monarchies, religions, and settings. Current LOCKED/CANON authority and all admitted legacy finals revealed no conflict requiring retcon or user ruling. Strict final names and universe integrity passed.

deltaDispositions.rationale: Records Istra’s complete local civil-service, discovery, emergency-water, inquiry, appointment, and family-fire history.
Records Kharost and Queen Orvessa IV as one continuous person, her nineteen-year office, choices, confession, injury, inquiry, loss of rule, and entry into the cooling works.
Records Estrel’s bounded human religious and emergency-coordination roles without supernaturalizing his response.
Records the forty-seven masks as a personified but nonliving, non-agentic, out-of-office collective distinct from Kharost and the dragons.
Records the eleven distinct unnamed individuals, their observed descriptions, the exact total of twelve, and the separation of Kharost’s new injury from the black dragon’s old scar.
Records the unnamed kingdom, capital, unspecified era, 218-year peace, and explicit lack of connection to named settings or the Sleepless Majesty polity.
Records the palace square, western arcade, cisterns, hydrants, fountains, sluices, Flood Bell, archives, undercroft cavern, and secret sleeping basin.
Records the separately supplied watershed, public ledger, twelve beds, soundproofing, inspector-tested external shutoffs, and human water control.
Records the exact twelve-dragon dynasty, forty-seven masks, rotating supporting roles, Kharost’s final mask, and separation from every other dragon collective.
Records the collective’s sincere sleep motive, six prevented wars, three prevented succession crises, reserves, sewers, cisterns, fire precautions, and the ethical limits of those accomplishments.
Records the office’s rods, ledgers, inspections, maxim, and rejection of royal seals as substitutes for verified quantities and revisable judgment.
Records the speech-derived state religion, white coats, clay lamps, forty-seven circles, forty-thousand-lamp preparation, and local separation of worship, office, and living power.
Records the Charter’s end of official worship, continued private remembrance, and compatibility with the established godhood taxonomy.
Records elected human control of law, water, taxation, records, and appointments; open audit; and the dragons’ non-ruling equal legal status.
Records the collective’s self-performed living human guises, continuing identities, and strict separation from other transformation systems.
Records Kharost’s heat, bounded fire resistance, split scale, the other dragon’s damaged wing membranes, and the dragons’ inability to contain the fire alone.
Records these twelve dragons’ local cool-stone, stable-water, low-vibration, quiet, bedding, bell, dripping-water, war, and fire sensitivities without generalizing dragon biology.
Records the Book’s extensive non-magical planning scope and its institutional failure to provide public correction.
Records the bell, sluices, hydrants, ledgers, basin, cooling works, seals, and archives as bounded non-agentic mechanical, hydraulic, legal, and archival systems.
Records the complete undated 218-year rule, forty-seven masks, governance, peace work, infrastructure, and sleep preparation.
Records the nineteen-month preparation, nine-hundred-thousand-gallon Founding Day diversion, royal-seal concealment, and forty-thousand-lamp Vigil preparation.
Records the gust, broken streamer, six lamps, dry fountain and hydrant, Istra’s ledger access, broken sluice chain, restored water, and Flood Bell.
Records Estrel’s coordination, Kharost’s confession and transformation, all twelve dragons’ bounded aid, the human response, lost roof, thirty-one treated injuries, and zero deaths.
Records the inquiry basis, six-week and nine-hundred-amendment process, retired masks, ended rule and state worship, elected councils, open audit, and non-ruling dragon status.
Records completion seven months after the fire, all twelve dragons entering for an intended two-century sleep, and continuing human control through external gates and public ledgers.
Defines the local non-magical administrative plan and excludes autonomous or universal legal meaning.
Defines the local constitutional transfer, audit regime, end of official worship, and non-ruling dragon status.
Defines the forty-seven retired masks and distinguishes them from Kharost, the dragons, and the Sleepless Majesty.
Defines the local obsolete emergency bell and excludes connections to other bell, time, and artifact systems.
Defines the annual local lamp-lit commemoration and state worship ended by the Charter.
Defines the municipal water office’s professional maxim and excludes magical, oath, truth, or universal-law effects.
